title: Adoption Timeline
description: Time-to-scale proxies across technology paradigms. The chart labels metric type and comparability so FORTRAN, ARPANET, iPhone, ChatGPT, and agentic tools are not treated as perfectly equivalent.

fields.Year: Launch year of technology or product
fields.Days_to_Adoption: Days to reach the stated proxy scale
fields.adoption_metric_type: Metric type: users, developers, devices, accounts, installs, or organizations
fields.comparability_notes: Why the proxy is or is not comparable with other rows

sources.name: Source review needed
sources.notes: Projection retained for chart continuity but flagged for source review

transformations: Log10(days) for y-axis. Metric types and comparability levels control marker shape. Trend line is a visual guide, not a causal model.
author: mschwar
